verdict.rationale: Benchmark Email's API page documents per-key, per-resource permissions (No Access, Read, or Read & Write across contacts, campaigns, reports and domains), plus optional expiration and deactivation per key. That lets an ops user mint a reports-read-only credential for an agent or contractor to pull analytics without write power over campaigns. missing for 10: explicit documentation that sending is gated by the campaigns write permission, independent or hands-on corroboration of the scoped-key behavior.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can mint scoped or read-only API credentials so an agent or contractor can read analytics without the power to send

citations.quote: Per-resource permissions: No Access, Read, or Read & Write (contacts, campaigns, reports, domains)
Optional expiration dates per key; deactivate and reactivate without rotating
Pull campaign results into your BI tool, your weekly digest, or whatever dashboard you actually look at.
